title: fix(service-analytics): a dataset selection asking one column twice is refused with a repair the selection can make, not the engine's "own 'alias'"
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XB1hsVtuncZ5F5C4zpiftHC)_

Fixes #28798

Clause-②: no — the accept set of `queryDataset` is unchanged on every face: each selection served on `main` is served, each refused is refused with status 400. Only the refusal's prescription moves, and the ObjectQL strategy now refuses these keys itself, right before `engine.aggregate`. Nothing is widened: no package-root export, public member, answer member, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs` quotes the duplicate-column refusal or tells a dataset author to alias a group entry.

Card thread: `session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据集查询里同一列被要两次（原始列加它自己的时间桶，或同一列的两个粒度），三条执行面（原生 SQL、ObjectQL、草稿预览）现在用同一个数据集拒绝回答。`code`、状态码、`param`、`path`、`object`、`fields` 都不变，只换处方：不再叫作者「给分组项起一个 alias」（数据集选择里没有 alias），而是点名选择里涉及这一列的成员，并给出能做的修法：去掉原始维度或去掉那个时间桶的粒度；两个粒度时只留一个。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28798（p3），是 PR #28794 合约评审的 should-fix 2。席位裁定：预览门变成数据集面唯一的拒绝，ObjectQL 策略在 `engine.aggregate` 之前调用它；引擎的文字不动。
- **风险与回滚**：接受集合不变（之前服务的仍服务，之前拒绝的仍 400 拒绝），只是拒绝文字变了。有一处要你知道：一个选择同时犯两个错（既把文本列按月分桶，又把同一列要两次）时，两个线上面以前答引擎的「非日期列不能分桶」（`INVALID_FIELD`），现在答本拒绝（`INVALID_QUERY`），与草稿预览原本的回答一致。见下文「一处优先级变化」。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-group-column-door.ts`（由 `preview-group-column-door.ts` 改名重写），`strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` 中 `execute` 和 `executeCrossObject` 在 `ctx.executeAggregate` 前各一行调用。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts`，预期 37 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地；那处优先级变化由席位裁定。

## What changes

- **One refusal for every dataset face.** `preview-group-column-door.ts` becomes `dataset-group-column-door.ts`, and `assertPreviewGroupColumnsDistinct(query, cube)` becomes `assertDatasetGroupColumnsDistinct(object, groupBy, query, memberColumn)`. It judges the `groupBy` keys it is handed, so each caller hands it the keys it built:
  - `ObjectQLStrategy.execute` calls it on `aggregateGroupKeys(query, cube)`, right before `ctx.executeAggregate`;
  - `executeCrossObject` calls it on its own keys (an FK column for a cross-object dimension), right before its base `ctx.executeAggregate`;
  - the draft preview calls it where it called the old door, on `aggregateGroupKeys(q, cube)` over `aggregateObjectOf(cube)`.

  Each call sits right before the engine call, so every refusal the strategy gave before keeps its precedence.
- **The sentence.** The head and tail are the engine's, so a reader of both sees the same shape. Only the prescription between them differs, and it names the selection's members over the column, read with the strategy's `resolveCubeFieldName`:
  - raw beside its bucket (either key the bare column): "The selection asks for 'closed_at' both raw and bucketed (`dimensions` 'closed_at'; `timeDimensions` 'OBJECT.closed_at' by month). Drop the raw dimension from `dimensions`, or drop the granularity from the `timeDimensions` entry."
  - two buckets: "The selection asks for 'closed_at' at two granularities (`timeDimensions` 'closed_at' by month, 'closed_at' by year). Ask one granularity of it in `timeDimensions`."

  A dimension bucketed by its own `timeDimensions` entry is not listed as raw. "Drop the granularity" rather than "drop the entry", because a `timeDimensions` entry without a granularity still windows the query.
- **Surface.** `resolveCubeFieldName` becomes a module-level export of `objectql-strategy.ts`, as `aggregateGroupKeys` and `aggregateObjectOf` already are. The package root re-exports `ObjectQLStrategy` by name only, so the root surface is unchanged. `ObjectQLStrategy` gains no member. The door imports only a type from the strategy module, so there is no runtime import cycle.
- **Untouched.** `packages/objectql` is untouched, and a direct `engine.aggregate` caller still gets the engine's "own 'alias'" prescription (pinned). `generateSql` (`/analytics/sql`, #28841) is untouched.
- Tests: `src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts` (34 → 37 cases). Changeset: `.changeset/28798-dataset-column-twice-refusal-prescription.md`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `fa59f787` with a probe over real SQLite (all three faces):

- **Every duplicate reaches the strategy.** Two keys over one column need a bucket, because the strategy names identical keys once (#28744). The native strategy declines every bucketed time dimension, so both live faces answered from the ObjectQL strategy's call into the engine. There is no native-own refusal on any of these selections. This held for raw beside a bucket of another spelling, a second dataset dimension over the column, and two buckets.
- **Every face prescribed the alias.** All three answered `… The query was NOT run. Give one of the group entries its own 'alias'. …`, and a dataset selection has no alias.
- **A direct `engine.aggregate`** with `['closed_at', { field: 'closed_at', dateGranularity: 'month' }]` answers the same refusal. That is the backstop this change leaves in place.

### One precedence change (for the seat's ruling)

The engine runs its other `groupBy` doors before the duplicate-column door. One of them refuses a date bucket over a non-date column (`INVALID_FIELD`). Measured on `main`, the selection `dimensions: ['region']` with `timeDimensions: [{ dimension: 'zone', granularity: 'month' }]` (`zone` is declared over the text column `region`) answered:

- both live faces: `INVALID_FIELD`, `groupBy.1.dateGranularity`;
- the draft preview: the column refusal.

With the door before `engine.aggregate`, as ruled, all three faces now answer the column refusal (`INVALID_QUERY`, `groupBy.1.field`). It is still a 400 refusal, and fixing it meets the other refusal. The new pin `[#28798] answers it on every face before the engine judges a bucket over a text column` holds this. No other measured selection changed. The os-dev-report carries this as an open question with options.

## Tests

<details><summary>Red first, green, ablations</summary>

- **Red on base.** `analytics-service.ts`, `strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` and `preview-group-column-door.ts` were restored to `fa59f787`, and the new door file was moved aside. The test stayed at HEAD. Result: `Tests 11 failed | 26 passed (37)`.
  - Every refusal case failed on the message: `Received: "… Give one of the group entries its own 'alias'. …"`.
  - The precedence pin failed on the live faces' `INVALID_FIELD`.
  - The direct-engine pin passed.

  Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, then `git status` was clean.
- **Green.** `37 passed (37)`. The full service-analytics suite gave `Test Files 203 passed (203)`, `Tests 4876 passed | 282 skipped`. `tsc --noEmit` and scoped eslint both exited 0.
- **Ablations** used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the fix committed first. Each anchor went 1 → 0, and each restore came back with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - A1: delete the `execute` call, so the engine answers again. Result: `9 failed | 27 passed`, every live-face refusal pin on the direct path.
  - A2: delete the `executeCrossObject` call. Result: `1 failed | 35 passed`, the cross-object pair.
  - A3: make the preview's call a no-op. Result: `9 failed | 27 passed`, because the preview serves both columns again.
  - A4: always use the two-granularity sentence. Result: `3 failed | 33 passed`, the raw-beside-bucket cases.
  - A5: list a dimension bucketed by its own entry as raw. Result: `1 failed | 36 passed`.
  - A6: compare a `timeDimensions` member's spelling instead of its column. Result: `5 failed | 32 passed`.
</details>

## Out of scope (reported to the seat, not fixed)

- On `main`, the draft preview serves a bucket over a text column (`timeDimensions: [{ dimension: 'zone', granularity: 'month' }]`) as one `null` bucket holding the total. Both live faces refuse it with `INVALID_FIELD`. That is a separate preview parity gap.
